findings.issue: SQL injection via unsanitized `sort` query param interpolated directly into ORDER BY clause in getReviewsSorted.
findings.evidence: `ORDER BY ${sort}` at stats.ts:46; api.ts:36 passes req.query.sort through with no allowlist, e.g. GET /api/books/1/reviews?sort=1;DROP TABLE users;--

findings.issue: Rating bounds check uses `&&` instead of `||`, so the out-of-range branch can never be true — invalid ratings (e.g. 0 or 6) bypass validation.
findings.evidence: if (!Number.isInteger(rating) || (rating < 1 && rating > 5)) { ... } — 0 < 1 is true but 0 > 5 is false, so && is false and validation passes.

findings.issue: Pagination off-by-one: OFFSET computed as page*pageSize while the function is documented as page starting at 1, so page=1 skips the first pageSize rows.
findings.evidence: // `page` starts at 1. ... [pageSize, page * pageSize] — for page=1, pageSize=10, OFFSET is 10 instead of 0.

findings.issue: Stored XSS: top.display_name (user-controlled) is interpolated unescaped into an HTML response via res.send template literal.
findings.evidence:
res.send(`
${top.display_name} rated it ${top.rating}/5
`) — a display_name of `` is reflected verbatim.
